Maria: Quick checks to run if you see issues:
```
# check canary redis evictions
curl -s http://metrics.internal/redis | jq '.evictions | .rate'
# basic tail latency query
curl -s http://metrics.internal/serve | jq '.tail_latency.p95'
```

- Maria: hold canary deploys until 23:45 (ack)
- Ben: delay CanaryA job (ack)
- Priya: review PR 452 (target 22:30)
- Alex: monitor canary for first 30m and be on-call for questions
If anything weird, drop notes here and tag @oncall-primary.
Priya: acked :+1:
Ben: ack
Maria: ack, will leave a watchlist comment in the console.

Alex: handing off to @Maria now for the night watch. I'm reachable on pager if needed. Good night :wave:
